newsitem.title: USA: Dow falls 50, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow falls 50, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 50 points in late trading Tuesday, but the session low was brief as the index quickly moved higher.
The 30-stock average fell 50 points or 0.70 percent to 7242, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to set curbs on index-arbitrage trading at 1516 EDT/1916 GMT.
But the index quickly rebounded. It was off 40 to 7252 just minutes later.
The Standard & Poor's 500 Index fell even lower on a percent basis, down 0.86 percent or seven to 830.
